description: US serial 73-1106. Delivered in the first batch of the type to the FAS on 15 June 1982 from Howard AFB; Panama; under project "ELSA"; and survived ten years of the civil war. Withdrawn after an accident landing on Ilopango runway 15 on 31 January 2010. On display inside the Segunda Brigada Aérea since August 2018. Photo credit C R Escobar.
aliases: A37B; A-37B; Dragonfly; Super Tweet; 73-1106; A37

description: US serial 68-10838. Delivered to the FAS on 2 November 1984 from Kelly AFB; Texas. Withdrawn after structural damage to the right wing in 2000. On display inside the Segunda Brigada Aérea. Photo credit C R Escobar.
